propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but omits the C901 cyclomatic-complexity shrink-only ratchet that is an equally hard CI blocker

The C901 ratchet (.github/complexity-baseline.json, threshold 15) fails the build when a function gains new complexity or exceeds its per-symbol ceiling, blocking routine work like adding CLI flags or guard clauses
Implementers discover the C901 failure only at pre-flight (make lint), forcing unplanned behavior-preserving extraction, because it is a structural gate the behavioral test oracle cannot detect
The fix to C901 failures is extraction (never baseline bumps), which must be documented alongside the module-size policy so implementers brief this constraint before ship

AGENTS.md must surface the C901 gate's name, baseline file, threshold source, enforcement command (make lint, ruff check, check_complexity_baseline.py --check), and remedy strategy alongside the module-size cap
